title: AccessPattern
description: A single named read or write operation against one collection, characterized by its key condition, optional sort and filter conditions, and operation category, as issued by application code or listed in a data-model design. It describes the request shape the application sends to the store, not a structure or computation stored in the engine. Use StoredLogic instead when the computation is defined and registered inside the database engine (SQL function or procedure, aggregation pipeline saved server-side, Lua script loaded via SCRIPT LOAD) rather than issued as a query from application code. Use View instead when the query is persisted in the schema as a named derived collection (CREATE VIEW, materialized view, search alias) that other queries read from. Use Index instead when the element is the physical lookup structure (CREATE INDEX, GSI, vector index) that makes a lookup efficient, not the lookup itself. Use EventHandler instead when the logic runs reactively in response to a data-change event (trigger, change stream, CDC consumer) rather than being requested by an application call.

patternType.description: Category of access pattern. POINT_READ: single-record lookup by key. RANGE_SCAN: ordered range of records. FULL_SCAN: all records. WRITE/UPSERT/BATCH_WRITE: mutation patterns. AGGREGATION: computed result over records. SEARCH: full-text or filtered search. VECTOR_SIMILARITY: approximate nearest neighbor. GRAPH_TRAVERSAL: multi-hop graph walk. TIME_RANGE/LATEST_VALUE: time-series queries.

targetCollection.description: The collection this access pattern operates on.

keyCondition.description: Key or partition condition for this access (e.g., 'customer_id = :id', 'PK = USER#:userId AND SK BEGINS_WITH ORDER#').

sortKey.description: Sort key expression for composite key patterns (e.g., 'SK BEGINS_WITH ORDER#', 'timestamp BETWEEN :start AND :end'). Used in DynamoDB/Cassandra to define the clustering dimension of the access pattern.

filterCondition.description: Additional filter condition applied after key lookup.

expectedFrequency.description: Expected frequency of this access pattern. Informs capacity planning and index decisions.

consistencyRequirement.description: Required consistency level for this access pattern.

x-source-reference.description: Source code reference using OpenAPI x- extension pattern.

x-dr-standard: ISO/IEC 9075-2 (Foundation) query specification and SQL-data change statements (approximate; the access pattern is a NoSQL data-modeling construct with no direct SQL counterpart)
x-dr-evidence: a repository or DAO method that issues one parameterized query against a single table or collection, e.g. Spring Data findByCustomerIdAndStatus, an @Query annotation, or a Mongoose Model.find({customerId}) call
a DynamoDB GetItem/Query/PutItem/BatchWriteItem call, or a Cassandra prepared statement, carrying a KeyConditionExpression or WHERE clause on partition and clustering keys
a data-model design document or single-table-design spreadsheet that enumerates access patterns with their PK/SK expressions, GSI used, and expected request rate
